Job Description (JD):
We are seeking a passionate and innovative Associate AI Engineer to join our growing technology team. In this role, you will work on cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, and Image Processing solutions for real-time applications and autonomous systems. You will be involved in the complete AI development lifecycle, including data preparation, model development, optimization, deployment, and integration with software and hardware platforms.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Develop and implement AI, Computer Vision, and Image Processing solutions for real-time applications and autonomous systems.
Design, train, test, and optimize deep learning models, particularly Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for tasks such as object detection, tracking, classification, segmentation, and recognition.
Develop AI applications using Python and perform dataset preparation, preprocessing, annotation, model training, validation, and performance optimization.
Deploy and optimize AI models on Edge Computing platforms including NVIDIA Jetson and Raspberry Pi for embedded and real-time processing applications.
Integrate AI modules with software systems, embedded hardware, and autonomous platforms while supporting testing, debugging, and technical documentation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams for AI development, deployment, and RD activities related to intelligent and autonomous systems.
Desired Skills:
Strong knowledge of Python, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Image Processing, and CNN architectures.
Experience in developing, training, and optimizing deep learning models.
Understanding of object detection, classification, tracking, segmentation, and recognition techniques.
Experience working with AI frameworks and image processing libraries.
Knowledge of dataset preparation, preprocessing, annotation, model validation, and performance optimization.
Experience with Edge AI platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson and Raspberry Pi.
Experience with PyMAVLink, DroneKit, and MAVLink communication protocols will be an added advantage.
Exposure to drone/UAV systems, autonomous technologies, and intelligent systems will be preferred.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Qualification : BCA, MCA, B.Tech, M.Tech in Computer Science.
Experience : 2-3 Years.
